period_note: Balance sheet is the period-end snapshot (reported, Solo/Standalone -- 'BALANCE SHEET' heading without the 'CONSOLIDATED' prefix used elsewhere in the same filing, per project convention of preferring Solo over Consolidated). Income-statement items are CUMULATIVE from 1 January 2017 (as published in UCB's own standalone unaudited interim financial statements filed on ucb.com.bd's investor-relations Financial Statements archive -- a different, richer source than the FY2013-2016 annual-report-embedded audit-committee table used elsewhere in this dataset) -- flagged via the _cumulative suffix, same convention as FY2013-2016. Most of this era's UCB interim-statement PDFs (2017 through 2023, plus 2025 Q1/Q2) are pure image scans with no embedded text layer, requiring tesseract 5.5.3 OCR (150dpi full-document pass to locate the Solo Balance Sheet/P&L/Notes pages, keyed off page headings, since page layout/count varies by year); the 2024 and 2025 Q3 filings do have an embedded text layer but it uses a corrupted font character-to-glyph mapping that pdftotext cannot read for numeric cells, so those were instead re-rendered at 300dpi and OCR'd the same way. All PDFs were downloaded directly from ucb.com.bd and deleted immediately after extraction per project policy. investments_securities and gross_loans are reconstructed from this report's own Government+Others and Loans-Cash-Credit+Bills-purchased component rows (both totals were OCR-corrupted in the top-line cell). total_equity (25,213,691,593), net_profit_after_tax_cumulative (1,156,524,215), eps_cumulative (1.10) and nav_per_share (23.92) were all OCR-corrupted in this report's own poorly-scanned pages and are instead taken from -- and exactly cross-validated by -- next year's Q2-2018 report's own comparative ('30-Jun-17') column, which is a clean native-text PDF. nocfps_cumulative (2.18) is similarly sourced from the FY2018 Q2 report's comparative column (no NAVPS/NOCFPS note yet existed in UCB's own 2017 interim filings). total_assets has an immaterial ~BDT 2m (0.0006%) identity gap between the printed top-line figure and Total Liabilities+Equity, attributable to residual OCR noise in a scanned 2017 filing; not adjusted since sub-materiality threshold.
